title: Backend follow-ups from the page batches: invoice issue date + terms, dashboard report date range, previous-period rows, follow-up status filter
goal: Close the backend gaps the desktop page batches (B18, B19, B22) had to work around, additively, so the desktop can drop its workarounds.
context: Added by the orchestrator 2026-10-06 from desktop/audit/fix/requests/B18.md and B22.md and the B19 hand-off. Baseline: backend vitest 39 files / 1068 passed, tsc 0. A schema-drift guard test (backend/test/schema-drift.test.ts) compares tenant-schema.ts with the migrated DB - every new column needs BOTH a migration and the schema entry. Next free migration number: 0039. Response shapes must stay additive for the Flutter apps (grep packages/shared/lib, packages/crm_app/lib) and the desktop (desktop/src/lib/api).
steps: Invoices: the desktop new/edit forms send `issueDate` and `terms`, but invoices have no issue_date column and terms is not persisted (detail falls back to created_at). Add migration 0039 with invoices.issue_date (TEXT ISO date, nullable; backfill from date(created_at)) and invoices.terms (TEXT, nullable) if missing; add both to tenant-schema.ts and the invoice validators; accept them on POST and PUT; return `issueDate` and `terms` on GET /invoices and GET /invoices/:id (additive). Tests: create with issueDate+terms -> read back; update -> read back; omitted -> issueDate defaults to the creation date.

Reports: `GET /reports/dashboard` takes no date filter - accept optional date_from/date_to (and the same presets the other reports accept) and apply them to its figures; unchanged behaviour when omitted. Test both.

Report engine `previous_period`: for ungrouped multi-row reports it returns only the first row. Return the full previous-period row set in the same shape as the current-period rows (additive: keep any existing summary field). Test with a report that returns several rows.

Follow-ups: `GET /follow-ups` only returns pending items, so the desktop cannot show completed follow-ups (e.g. for a contact's last interaction). Add an optional `status` query (pending | completed | cancelled | all; default keeps today's behaviour = pending) that composes with the existing filters incl. contactId. Test.
Run the full suite and tsc; prove migrations 0000-0039 apply on an empty DB (the schema-drift guard does this).
acceptance: Invoice issueDate and terms round-trip through POST/PUT/GET; schema-drift guard passes.
GET /reports/dashboard honours date_from/date_to; previous_period returns all rows.
notes: Report the exact new/changed request and response fields so the desktop sweep (B30) can remove the workarounds in dashboard-data.ts, invoices edit, and contacts detail.
